title: Kuɗi da kasuwa
description: Ten short stories about money and shopping in Hausaland: a grain trader in Dawanau whose scale is doubted, a mother and daughter buying pots and bowls for a new home, a soap maker in Zaria, a young man's second-hand motorcycle in Katsina, a boy's long trousers for the cold season in Sokoto, a senator's campaign in a Kano market, a jeweller's journey to Agadez for silver, a folk tale about a clever girl and a monster on the market road, furniture made by prisoners for flood victims and an engineer's grinding machine in Gombe.

lessons.title: Ma'aunin Malam Sabi'u
lessons.summary: In the Dawanau grain market in Kano, Hajiya Ummaiya says Malam Sabi'u's scale cheats; the imam of the market reads a verse about fair measure and tests the scale against the government one, and it is her own scale at home that was wrong.
lessons.text:
Malam Sabi'u ɗan kasuwa ne a kasuwar Dawanau a Kano, inda ake sayar da hatsi. Kowace safiya yakan baje shinkafa da wake a gaban shagonsa. Bayan ya baje kayansa, sai ya ajiye ma'auninsa a kan tebur. Ma'aunin tsoho ne, amma Malam Sabi'u yana kula da shi sosai.

Wata rana, wata mace mai suna Ummaiya ta zo ta sayi wake. Malam Sabi'u ya ɗora mata waken a kan ma'auni, ta biya, ta tafi. Bayan awa biyu, sai ta dawo da fushi. Ta ce, "Na gwada wannan waken a kan ma'aunin gidana, kuma ban gamsu ba. Ina ganin ma'auninka ba shi da daidaito."

Malam Sabi'u ya ce, "Wallahi, ma'aunina na gaskiya ne. Ban taɓa cutar kowa ba." Amma Ummaiya ba ta gamsu ba. Ta ce, "Kowa yana cewa 'wallahi'. Ni dai ina so in ga gaskiya da idona."

Mutane da yawa suka zo gaban shagon. Wani dattijo ya ce, "Ku haƙura dukanku. Bari mu kai ma'aunin wurin babban malamin masallacin kasuwa. Yana da ma'aunin gwamnati." Malam Sabi'u ya haƙura, bai yi faɗa ba.

Da suka isa masallacin kasuwar, malamin ya saurare su. Sannan ya karanta wata aya daga Alƙur'ani. Ya ce, "Wannan aya tana cewa mu cika ma'auni, kada mu rage wa mutane kayansu. Allah yana son daidaito." Bayan haka, ya ɗora waken a kan ma'aunin Malam Sabi'u, sannan a kan ma'aunin gwamnati. Nauyin ya yi daidai.

Ummaiya ta ji kunya. Ta ce, "Ka yi haƙuri, Malam. Ashe ma'aunin gidana ne ba shi da daidaito." Malam Sabi'u ya ce, "Babu komai. Na haƙura tun da farko."

Sai malamin ya ce wa mutanen kasuwar cewa ɗan kasuwa yana samun ƙima ne ta gaskiyarsa. Ya ce, "Muddin ma'auninku yana da daidaito, mutane za su amince da ku. Amma idan kuka yi ƙarya, mutane za su daina ba ku ƙima, kuma cinikinku zai ragu."

Bayan mako ɗaya, farashin wake ya ragu a kasuwa, saboda manoma sun sami amfanin gona mai yawa. Ummaiya ta dawo wurin Malam Sabi'u ta sayi wake mai yawa. Ta ce, "Na zo wurinka ne saboda yanzu na gamsu da gaskiyarka." Malam Sabi'u ya ce, "Muddin ina raye, ma'aunina ba zai yi ƙarya ba." Tun daga ranar, Malam Sabi'u ya sami ƙima sosai a kasuwar Dawanau.

Tambayoyi:
Me Malam Sabi'u yakan yi kowace safiya?
Yakan baje shinkafa da wake a gaban shagonsa.
Me ya sa Ummaiya ta dawo da fushi?
Ta dawo da fushi saboda ba ta gamsu da ma'aunin Malam Sabi'u ba.
Me malamin ya karanta?
Ya karanta wata aya da take cewa mu cika ma'auni.
Wane ma'auni ne ba shi da daidaito?
Ma'aunin gidan Ummaiya ne ba shi da daidaito.
Me ya sa farashin wake ya ragu?
Farashin ya ragu saboda manoma sun sami amfanin gona mai yawa.

lessons.title: Kayan girkin Khairat
lessons.summary: Before her wedding, Khairat goes with her mother Hajjo to the Sabon Gari market to buy pots, bowls and glasses; the smiling trader Malam Adnan presses a cheap bowl to show it bends, they choose strong ones, and at home Khairat squeezes oranges into the new glasses.
lessons.text:
Khairat za ta yi aure a wata mai zuwa. Wata safiya mahaifiyarta Hajjo ta ce mata, "Yau za mu je Kasuwar Sabon Gari mu sayi kayan girkinki. Waɗanne kaya kike so?"

Khairat ta ce, "Ina son tukunya babba da ƙarama, da kwano shida, da gilashi goma sha biyu." Mahaifiyarta ta ce, "To, mu tafi. Amma kada ki sayi kaya marasa kyau saboda farashinsu ya yi sauƙi."

Da suka isa kasuwar, suka shiga shagon wani ɗan kasuwa mai suna Malam Adnan. Shagon cike yake da tukwane da kwanoni da gilashi. Malam Adnan ya karɓe su da murmushi. Ya tambayi Khairat, "Yarinya, me kike nema?" Ta ce, "Tukwane da kwanoni da gilashi."

Malam Adnan ya nuna mata tukwane iri biyu. Ya ce, "Waɗanne kike so? Waɗannan na ƙarfe ne, waɗancan kuma na ƙasa." Khairat ta zaɓi tukunya babba ta ƙarfe. Mahaifiyarta ta ce, "Ba mu gama ba tukuna. Ki duba ƙasanta da kyau."

Sannan suka duba kwanoni. Akwai kwano mai sauƙin farashi da kwano mai tsada. Malam Adnan ya ɗauki kwano mai sauƙi, ya matsa shi da hannunsa. Kwanon ya lanƙwasa. Sai ya matsa ɗayan kwanon, amma ko kaɗan bai motsa ba. Ya ce da murmushi, "Kun gani? Kwano mai tsada yana da ƙarfi. Ba zan ba ku kaya marasa kyau ba."

Hajjo ta yi murmushi. Ta ce, "Ka yi gaskiya. Za mu ɗauki kwanoni masu ƙarfi guda shida." Khairat ta tambaye ta, "Mama, mun gama?" Mahaifiyarta ta ce, "A'a, ba mu gama ba tukuna. Akwai gilashi."

Khairat ta ɗauki gilashi ɗaya ta duba shi a hasken rana. Gilashin yana da haske kamar ruwa. Ta ce, "Ina son waɗannan gilashin." Malam Adnan ya naɗe kowane gilashi a takarda, don kada ya fashe a hanya.

Da suka yi lissafi, kuɗin ya yi yawa. Hajjo ta ce wa Malam Adnan ya rage kaɗan. Ya yi tunani, sannan ya rage farashin tukunya ɗaya. Suka biya, suka gode masa.

A gida, Khairat ta ajiye sabuwar tukunyarta da kwanonin a ɗaki. Sannan ta matsa lemu cikin sabbin gilashi biyu, ta ba mahaifiyarta ɗaya. Hajjo ta sha, ta yi murmushi, ta ce, "Yanzu gidanki ya shirya."

Tambayoyi:
Waɗanne kaya Khairat take so ta saya?
Tana son tukunya babba da ƙarama, da kwano shida, da gilashi goma sha biyu.
Me Malam Adnan ya yi da kwano mai sauƙin farashi?
Ya matsa shi da hannunsa, sai kwanon ya lanƙwasa.
Wace tukunya Khairat ta zaɓa?
Ta zaɓi tukunya babba ta ƙarfe.
Me Khairat ta yi da gilashi a hasken rana?
Ta duba shi, sai ta ga yana da haske kamar ruwa.
Me Khairat ta yi a gida?
Ta matsa lemu cikin sabbin gilashi, ta ba mahaifiyarta.

lessons.title: Sabulun Tasalla
lessons.summary: In Zaria, Tasalla makes bar soap at home; when the cold season brings colds and a health worker tells mothers to wash their children's hands, she comes up with liquid soap poured through a funnel into bottles, and her son Muttaka cleans the bottles.
lessons.text:
Tasalla tana zaune a Zaria tare da ɗanta Muttaka. Tana sayar da sabulu domin ta sami kuɗin abinci da na makaranta. Kowane mako tana dafa sabulu a babbar tukunya, sannan ta zuba shi a kan tebur. Idan sabulun ya bushe, sai ta yanka shi ƙanana. Sabulu yana ɗaukar mako uku kafin ya bushe sosai.

Mata da yawa suna sayen sabulun Tasalla, saboda yana cire datti da kyau. Suna cewa, "Datti ba ya tsayawa a kan tufafi idan an wanke su da sabulun Tasalla."

A lokacin sanyi, yara da yawa a unguwarsu suka kamu da mura. Wata jami'ar lafiya ta zo ta yi magana da iyaye a ƙofar masallaci. Ta ce, "Tsafta ita ce maganin cututtuka da yawa. Idan yaro yana da mura, ya wanke hannunsa da sabulu kafin ya ci abinci. Ku kula da tsaftar gidajenku."

Tasalla ta yi tunani. Ta ce wa kanta, "Yara ba sa son wanke hannu da babban sabulu mai nauyi. Idan na yi sabulun ruwa a ƙananan kwalabe, zai fi musu sauƙi." Sai ta ɓullo da sabon tunani: sabulun ruwa mai ƙamshi.

Ta sayi tsofaffin kwalabe a kasuwa, amma kwalaben suna cike da datti. Muttaka ya ce, "Mama, zan tsabtace su." Ya wanke kowace kwalba da ruwan zafi, ya tsabtace su har suka yi fari, sannan ya ajiye su a rana su bushe.

Kwalaben suna da ƙananan bakuna, sai Tasalla ta sayi bututu. Ta sa bututun a bakin kwalba, ta zuba sabulun ruwa ta cikinsa. Da bututun, sabulun bai zube a ƙasa ba.

Bayan mako biyu, mata suka fara sayen sabulun ruwan. Yara suna son ƙamshinsa, kuma suna wanke hannayensu kafin abinci. Mura ta ragu a unguwar. Jami'ar lafiyar ta yi farin ciki. Ta ce, "Wannan sabon tunani ne da kika ɓullo da shi. Tsafta ta ƙaru a unguwar nan."

Ciniki ya ƙaru sosai. Tasalla ta ce wa Muttaka, "Ina tunanin ƙarawa a kan farashin kwalba ɗaya." Muttaka ya ce, "Mama, kada ki yi ƙarawa yanzu. Mutane sun fara son sabulunki. Ki bar farashin kamar yadda yake." Tasalla ta yarda. Maimakon ƙarawa a farashi, sai ta yi ƙarawa a yawan kwalaben da take yi kowane mako.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa mata suke sayen sabulun Tasalla?
Saboda yana cire datti da kyau.
Me jami'ar lafiya ta ce game da tsafta?
Ta ce tsafta ita ce maganin cututtuka da yawa.
Wane tunani Tasalla ta ɓullo da shi?
Ta ɓullo da tunanin sabulun ruwa mai ƙamshi a ƙananan kwalabe.
Me Muttaka ya yi da tsofaffin kwalaben?
Ya wanke su da ruwan zafi, ya tsabtace su, ya ajiye su a rana su bushe.
Me ya sa Tasalla ta sayi bututu?
Saboda kwalaben suna da ƙananan bakuna, kuma ba ta son sabulun ya zube.

lessons.title: Babur ɗin Nafi'u
lessons.summary: In Katsina, Nafi'u buys a second-hand motorcycle from Malam Dantani to carry passengers, ties an old woman's sack on with rope, swerves when a goat suddenly runs out, and finds a mechanic before he trusts the brakes again.
lessons.text:
Nafi'u matashi ne a Katsina. Mahaifinsa ya rasu shekara biyu da suka wuce, kuma mahaifiyarsa da 'yan uwansa uku suna dogaro da shi. Ya daɗe yana ajiye kuɗi domin ya sayi babur. Yana so ya riƙa ɗaukar fasinja a kan babur, domin ya sami kuɗi kowace rana.

Wata rana ya je wurin wani mutum mai suna Malam Dantani, wanda yake sayar da tsofaffin babura. Malam Dantani ya nuna masa wani babur ja. Ya ce, "Wannan babur ya yi tafiyar mil dubu uku kawai. Injinsa yana da kyau." Nafi'u ya duba babur ɗin, ya hau shi, ya yi tafiya kaɗan da shi. Ya ce, "Na gamsu."

Ya biya Malam Dantani kuɗin. Malam Dantani ya ba shi babur ɗin ya ce, "Yanzu wannan babur naka ne. Allah ya sa ka sami albarka da shi. Amma ka riƙa tafiya a hankali." Nafi'u ya ce, "Na gode. Babur ɗin nan naka ne a da, yanzu kuma nawa ne."

Bayan kwana ɗaya, fasinjarsa ta farko wata tsohuwar mace ce da take zuwa kasuwa. Tana da babbar jaka ta shinkafa. Nafi'u ya nemo igiya, ya ɗaure jakar a bayan babur da igiyar. Ya ce mata, "Mama, ki riƙe ni kam." Tsohuwar ta riƙe shi kam, suka tafi.

A kan hanya, sai kwatsam wani kare ya fito daga gefen hanya. Nafi'u ya riƙe babur ɗin kam, ya juya shi. Bai buge karen ba, kuma tsohuwar ba ta faɗi ba. Amma ya ji cewa birkin babur ɗin ba shi da ƙarfi.

Da suka isa kasuwa, sai ga wani rami a gaban ƙofar kasuwa. Nafi'u ya tsaya. Tsohuwar ta sauka, ta tsallake ramin da ƙafa. Ta ce, "Ba sai ka tsallake ramin da babur ba. Zan tsallake shi da kaina." Ta biya shi kuɗinsa, ta ce, "Allah ya kiyaye ka."

Nafi'u bai ɗauki wani fasinja ba a ranar. Ya ce wa kansa, "Iyalina suna dogaro da ni. Ba zan ɗauki fasinja ba sai na gyara birkin nan." Ya bi gari yana neman mai gyaran babura. A ƙarshe ya nemo wani tsoho mai gyaran babura kusa da tasha. Tsohon ya gyara birkin, ya ce, "Kwatsam hatsari yake zuwa. Ka riƙa duba birkinka kowane mako."

Tun daga ranar, Nafi'u yakan duba babur ɗinsa kowace safiya kafin ya fita neman fasinja.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa iyalin Nafi'u suke dogaro da shi?
Saboda mahaifinsa ya rasu, kuma shi yake neman kuɗi.
Mil nawa babur ɗin ya yi?
Ya yi mil dubu uku kawai.
Me Nafi'u ya yi da jakar tsohuwar?
Ya nemo igiya, ya ɗaure jakar a bayan babur.
Me ya faru a kan hanya?
Kwatsam wani kare ya fito, sai Nafi'u ya juya babur ɗin.
Yaya tsohuwar ta wuce ramin?
Ta sauka, ta tsallake ramin da ƙafa.

lessons.title: Wandon Abdulaziz
lessons.summary: In the harsh Sokoto cold season, Abdulaziz begs his mother Altine for long trousers; she says he will deserve them if he passes his exams, he does, and the tailor Malam Ilu sews them with black thread for the Friday prayer.
lessons.text:
A Sokoto, lokacin hunturu yana da sanyi sosai. Iska tana busawa da safe, kuma ƙura tana rufe rana. A wannan shekara, an yi matsanancin sanyi wanda tsofaffi suka ce ba su taɓa ganin irinsa ba.

Abdulaziz yaro ne ɗan shekara goma sha ɗaya. Yana da gajeren wando guda biyu kawai. Kowace safiya idan ya tafi makaranta, sanyi yana kama ƙafafunsa. Wata rana ya roƙi mahaifiyarsa Altine ta saya masa dogon wando. Ya ce, "Mama, don Allah ki saya mini dogon wando. Matsanancin sanyin nan yana cutar da ni."

Mahaifiyarsa ta ce, "Ka san cewa kuɗi ba su da yawa a wannan lokaci. Amma idan ka ci jarrabawarka ta ƙarshen shekara, za ka cancanta da sabon wando." Abdulaziz bai sake roƙa ba. Ya fara karatu da dare kusa da fitila.

Bayan mako uku, malaminsa ya ba shi takardar sakamako. Ya zama na biyu a ajinsu. Ya gudu gida ya nuna wa mahaifiyarsa. Ta karanta takardar ta ce, "Oh! Abdulaziz, na yi farin ciki. Ka cancanta da wando, kuma za mu saya maka yau."

Suka je kasuwa suka sayi yadi mai kauri, launin ruwan ƙasa. Sannan suka kai shi wurin wani tela mai suna Malam Ilu. Malam Ilu ya auna ƙafafun Abdulaziz. Ya tambaye su, "Wane irin zare kuke so? Akwai zare baƙi, da zare fari, da zare ja." Abdulaziz ya ce, "Zare baƙi, don Allah."

Malam Ilu ya ce, "Oh, kana da hankali. Zare baƙi ba ya nuna datti." Ya ce su dawo bayan kwana biyu. Abdulaziz ya roƙi Malam Ilu ya gama kafin ranar Juma'a, domin yana so ya tafi masallaci da sabon wandonsa. Malam Ilu ya yi dariya ya ce, "Tun da ka ci jarrabawa, ka cancanta. Zan gama ranar Alhamis."

Ranar Juma'a da safe, Abdulaziz ya fito sanye da sabon wando, da riga, da hula. Kakansa ya gan shi sanye da kaya masu kyau ya ce, "Yau ka yi kamar babban mutum!" Matsanancin sanyin hunturu bai dame shi ba kuma. Ya ce wa mahaifiyarsa, "Na gode, Mama. Zan ci gaba da karatu sosai."

Tambayoyi:
Yaya sanyi yake a Sokoto a lokacin hunturu?
Sanyi yana da yawa, kuma a wannan shekara an yi matsanancin sanyi.
Me Abdulaziz ya roƙi mahaifiyarsa?
Ya roƙe ta ta saya masa dogon wando.
Me ya sa Abdulaziz ya cancanta da sabon wando?
Saboda ya ci jarrabawarsa, ya zama na biyu a ajinsu.
Wane zare Abdulaziz ya zaɓa?
Ya zaɓi zare baƙi.
Me Abdulaziz yake sanye da shi ranar Juma'a?
Yana sanye da sabon wando, da riga, da hula.

lessons.title: Sanata a kasuwa
lessons.summary: Alhaji Mudi, acting chairman of the Sabon Gari traders in Kano, is invited to a senator's campaign feast; he tells Senator Abdulmumin that the traders criticise him because statistics do not mend the flooded drains, and they back him only after the problem is solved.
lessons.text:
Alhaji Mudi ɗan kasuwa ne a Kasuwar Sabon Gari a Kano. Shugaban ƙungiyar 'yan kasuwa ya tafi aikin Hajji, sai aka naɗa Alhaji Mudi muƙaddashin shugaban ƙungiyar har sai shugaban ya dawo.

Wata rana, Sanata Abdulmumin ya zo kasuwar a lokacin kamfe. Zaɓe ya rage wata biyu. Sanatan ya zo da motoci da yawa, da mutane masu ɗauke da hotunansa. Ya gayyaci shugabannin 'yan kasuwa zuwa liyafa a gidansa ranar Asabar.

Alhaji Mudi ya je liyafar a matsayin muƙaddashin shugaban 'yan kasuwa. A liyafar akwai abinci iri iri: shinkafa, nama, kaza, da abin sha. Sanatan ya ce, "Alfarma ce a gare ni da kuka zo liyafata." Alhaji Mudi ya ce, "Mu ma alfarma ce a gare mu da ka gayyace mu."

Bayan an ci abinci, sanatan ya ce, "Ina so ku goyi bayana a zaɓe mai zuwa." Alhaji Mudi ya ce, "Ranka ya daɗe, ina so in faɗi gaskiya. 'Yan kasuwa suna sukar ka. Duk lokacin damina, ruwa yana cika kasuwa saboda magudanan ruwa sun lalace. A kamfe na baya, ka ce za ka gyara su, amma ba a gyara ba."

Sanatan bai ji daɗin wannan suka ba, amma ya saurara. Sannan ya ɗauki wata takarda ya ce, "Ga ƙididdiga. Na gina makarantu goma, na gyara asibitoci biyar, na ba matasa dubu bashi." Alhaji Mudi ya ce, "Wannan ƙididdiga tana da kyau. Amma ƙididdiga ba za ta warware matsalar ruwa a kasuwarmu ba."

Kowa ya yi shiru. Sai sanatan ya yi dariya ya ce, "Ka yi gaskiya, Alhaji. Ban ji daɗin sukar ba, amma sukar gaskiya magani ce. Zan warware wannan matsala kafin zaɓe."

Bayan mako uku, ma'aikata suka zo kasuwar da manyan motoci. Suka gyara magudanan ruwa duka. Da aka yi ruwan sama, ruwa bai cika kasuwa ba. 'Yan kasuwa suka yi murna.

Alhaji Mudi ya kira taron 'yan kasuwa. Ya ce, "Sanata ya warware matsalarmu. Ni dai zan goyi bayansa, amma kowa yana da 'yancin zaɓen wanda yake so." Yawancin 'yan kasuwar suka ce za su goyi bayan sanatan. Bayan zaɓe, shugaban ƙungiyar ya dawo daga Hajji, sai Alhaji Mudi ya bar matsayin muƙaddashin shugaba.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa aka naɗa Alhaji Mudi muƙaddashin shugaban ƙungiyar?
Saboda shugaban ƙungiyar ya tafi aikin Hajji.
Ina sanatan ya gayyaci shugabannin 'yan kasuwa?
Ya gayyace su zuwa liyafa a gidansa.
Wace suka 'yan kasuwa suke yi wa sanatan?
Sun ce ya ce zai gyara magudanan ruwa, amma ba a gyara ba.
Me Alhaji Mudi ya ce game da ƙididdigar sanatan?
Ya ce ƙididdiga ba za ta warware matsalar ruwa a kasuwarsu ba.
Me ya faru bayan mako uku?
Ma'aikata suka zo suka gyara magudanan ruwa duka.

lessons.title: Azurfa daga Agadez
lessons.summary: Fa'iza, a jewellery seller in Kano, travels by bus through the desert to Agadez; a sandstorm with thunder frightens her at a camp, and the silversmith Hamidan greets her and sells her forty silver rings.
lessons.text:
Fa'iza tana sayar da kayan ado a Kano. Mata suna son kayan azurfa da take sayar da su, amma azurfa mai kyau tana da wuya a samu a Kano. Wata mace ta faɗa mata cewa a Agadez, a Jamhuriyar Nijar, akwai mutane da suke yin kayan azurfa masu kyau sosai.

Fa'iza ta shirya tafiya. Ta hau bas daga Kano zuwa Zinder, sannan daga Zinder zuwa Agadez. Bayan Zinder, hanyar ta shiga hamada. Ba ta taɓa ganin hamada ba. Ƙasa ce kawai ko'ina, babu bishiyoyi, babu ruwa.

Da yamma bas ɗin ya tsaya a wani zango a cikin hamada. A zangon akwai ruwa, da masallaci, da wuraren sayar da abinci. Masu tafiya sukan kwana a zangon kafin su ci gaba da tafiya.

Da dare, sai iska mai ƙarfi ta taso, tana ɗauke da ƙura. Sama ta yi duhu, kuma aka yi tsawa mai ƙarfi. Fa'iza ta tsorata sosai. Ba ta taɓa jin tsawa irin wannan ba. Wata tsohuwar mace da take zaune kusa da ita ta ce, "Kada ki tsorata. Tsawa tana zuwa a hamada, amma ba ta daɗewa." Bayan awa ɗaya, tsawar ta tsaya, iskar ma ta tsaya.

Da safe suka isa Agadez. Fa'iza ta tambayi mutane inda masu yin azurfa suke, sai aka kai ta wurin wani mutum mai suna Hamidan. Hamidan ya ce mata, "Salam!" Ta ce, "Salam! Ina kwana?" Ya ce, "Lafiya. Barka da zuwa Agadez." Gaisuwarsa ta sa ta ji daɗi. Bayan gaisuwa, ya kawo mata shayi.

Hamidan ya nuna mata kayan azurfa da ya yi da hannunsa. Fa'iza ta ce, "Ina son zobe arba'in." Hamidan ya ce, "Arba'in? Wannan ciniki ne babba!" Suka yi ciniki har suka yarda da farashi. Ta biya shi, ya naɗe zobban arba'in a cikin zane.

Kafin ta tafi, Hamidan ya ce, "Ki kai gaisuwata ga matan Kano. Ki faɗa musu cewa wannan azurfa ta Agadez ce."

A hanyar komawa, bas ɗin ya sake tsayawa a zangon nan. Wannan karon babu tsawa, kuma Fa'iza ba ta tsorata ba. Da ta isa Kano, mata suka zo shagonta. Cikin mako ɗaya, ta sayar da talatin daga cikin zobban arba'in.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Fa'iza ta tafi Agadez?
Ta tafi ne domin ta sayi azurfa mai kyau.
Me ke cikin zangon da bas ɗin ya tsaya?
Akwai ruwa, da masallaci, da wuraren sayar da abinci.
Me ya sa Fa'iza ta tsorata da dare?
Saboda iska mai ƙarfi ta taso, kuma aka yi tsawa mai ƙarfi.
Yaya Hamidan ya gaishe ta?
Ya ce mata, "Salam!", sannan ya kawo mata shayi.
Zobe nawa Fa'iza ta saya?
Ta sayi zobe arba'in.

lessons.title: Bahijja da dodo
lessons.summary: A folk tale: a monster robs traders on the road to the market, so they avoid it; a monkey, one of the monster's enemies, tells the rich trader Attahiru's clever daughter Bahijja that it fears salt, she drives it away with salt, and her father names her his heir.
lessons.text:
A zamanin da, akwai wani attajiri mai suna Attahiru. Yana sayar da gishiri da zane a kasuwar wani babban gari. Ba shi da ɗa namiji, sai 'ya ɗaya mai suna Bahijja. Mutane suka ce, "Wa zai zama magajin Attahiru? Ba shi da magaji."

A hanyar kasuwar akwai wani babban daji, kuma a cikin dajin akwai wani dodo. Dodon yana da girma kamar giwa, kuma yana da idanu ja. Idan 'yan kasuwa suka wuce, sai dodon ya fito, ya ƙwace kayansu. Saboda haka, 'yan kasuwa suka fara kaucewa hanyar. Suna bin wata doguwar hanya, domin su kauce wa dodon. Kaucewa hanyar ya sa tafiya ta yi tsawo, kuma farashin kaya ya hau.

Dodon yana da maƙiya da yawa a cikin daji, saboda yana karya bishiyoyi yana cin 'ya'yansu. Birai su ne manyan maƙiyansa, domin bishiyoyinsu ne yake karyawa.

Wata rana Bahijja ta je bakin daji. Sai ta ga wani biri a kan bishiya yana kuka. Ta ce, "Biri, me ya same ka?" Birin ya ce, "Dodo ya karya bishiyarmu. Shi ne maƙiyinmu, kuma maƙiyan dodo suna da yawa. Amma ina da wani sirri: dodon yana tsoron gishiri. Idan gishiri ya taɓa jikinsa, sai ya gudu."

Bahijja yarinya ce mai wayo. Ta koma gida ta ɗauki buhunan gishiri na mahaifinta guda uku. Da wayonta, ta ɗora buhunan a kan jaki, ta bi hanyar daji kamar 'yar kasuwa.

Da dodon ya ji motsinta, ya fito daga daji. Sai Bahijja ta buɗe buhu, ta watsa masa gishiri. Dodon ya yi ihu, ya juya ya gudu. Birai suka sauka daga bishiyoyi, suka kora shi da duwatsu. Suka kora shi har ya bar dajin gaba ɗaya, bai dawo ba.

'Yan kasuwa suka daina kaucewa hanyar. Tafiya ta yi sauƙi, kuma farashin kaya ya sauka. Mutane suka zo gidan Attahiru suka yi masa godiya.

Attahiru ya tara mutanen gari ya ce, "Kun ce ba ni da magaji. Ga 'yata Bahijja. Da wayonta ta kori dodo daga hanyarmu. Ita ce magajiyata." Tun daga lokacin, Bahijja ta zama babbar 'yar kasuwa, kuma ba ta manta da birai ba. Kowace shekara takan kai musu ayaba.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa 'yan kasuwa suka fara kaucewa hanyar daji?
Saboda dodo yana fitowa yana ƙwace kayansu.
Su waye maƙiyan dodon?
Dabbobin daji, musamman birai, domin yana karya bishiyoyinsu.
Wane sirri birin ya faɗa wa Bahijja?
Ya faɗa mata cewa dodon yana tsoron gishiri.
Yaya Bahijja ta kori dodon?
Ta watsa masa gishiri, sai ya gudu, birai kuma suka kora shi.
Wa Attahiru ya ce shi ne magajinsa?
Ya ce 'yarsa Bahijja ce magajiyarsa.

lessons.title: Kujerun fursunoni
lessons.summary: Salma wants wooden chairs and visits the prison shop in Kano, where officer Shamsuddeen explains that the prisoners have chosen to give their share of the sales to the families of the Bagwai flood, from which soldiers rescued many people; she buys four chairs.
lessons.text:
Salma ta gina sabon gida a Kano, tana neman kujeru na katako. Kujerun katako a kasuwa suna da tsada. Wata ƙawarta ta ce mata, "Ki je shagon gidan yari. Fursunoni ne suke yin kujeru da tebura na katako a can, kuma farashinsu ba shi da yawa."

Salma ta je gidan yarin. A ƙofa, wani jami'i mai suna Shamsuddeen ya gaishe ta. Ya ce, "Barka da zuwa. Duk kayan da kike gani a nan, fursunoni ne suka yi su da katako. Suna koyon aikin katako a nan, domin idan sun fita, su sami sana'a."

Salma ta ga kujeru masu kyau. Ta tambaya, "Kuɗin da ake samu, ina yake zuwa?" Shamsuddeen ya ce, "A da, ana raba kuɗin gida biyu: gidan yari yana ɗaukar rabi, fursunoni kuma suna ɗaukar rabi. Amma a wannan wata, fursunonin sun yanke shawara su sadaukar da nasu rabin."

Ya ci gaba da cewa, "Kina tuna bala'in ambaliya a Bagwai a watan da ya wuce? Kogi ya cika, ruwa ya rushe gidaje ɗari. Dakaru sun zo da jiragen ruwa, suka ceci mutane fiye da ɗari biyu. Amma iyalai da yawa da aka ceta sun rasa komai. Fursunoni da yawa daga Bagwai suke. Sun san wahalar da ke tattare da ambaliya, saboda haka suka ce za su sadaukar da kuɗinsu ga waɗanda bala'in ya shafa."

Salma ta yi mamaki. Shamsuddeen ya ce, "Ga ɗaya daga cikinsu, wanda dakaru suka ceci mahaifiyarsa daga ruwan."

A bayyane yake cewa aikin katako yana da wuya. Salma ta ga wani daga cikin fursunonin yana yanka katako da inji. Shamsuddeen ya ce, "Akwai haɗari tattare da wannan aiki, amma suna son shi."

Salma ta sayi kujeru huɗu. Ta ce, "Ina so in ga kuɗina ya isa wurin iyalan Bagwai." Shamsuddeen ya ce, "Za a ba da kuɗin a bayyane, a gaban 'yan jarida, ranar Litinin."

Ranar Litinin, Salma ta ga labarin a talabijin. An ba iyalan Bagwai kuɗi da abinci. Wata mace ta ce a talabijin, "Albarkacin fursunonin nan, yarana sun sami abinci." Salma ta ce wa kanta, "Albarkacin kujeruna huɗu, ni ma na taimaka kaɗan." Duk lokacin da ta zauna a kan kujerunta na katako, sai ta tuna da fursunonin da suka sadaukar da kuɗinsu.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Salma ta je shagon gidan yari?
Saboda tana neman kujeru na katako, kuma farashinsu ba shi da yawa a can.
Wane bala'i ya faru a Bagwai?
An yi ambaliya, kogi ya cika, ruwa ya rushe gidaje ɗari.
Me dakaru suka yi a Bagwai?
Sun zo da jiragen ruwa, suka ceci mutane fiye da ɗari biyu.
Me fursunonin suka sadaukar?
Sun sadaukar da rabin kuɗinsu ga iyalan da bala'in ya shafa.
Me matar ta ce a talabijin?
Ta ce albarkacin fursunonin, yaranta sun sami abinci.

lessons.title: Injin niƙan Hadiyya
lessons.summary: In Gombe, the engineer Hadiyya sees the women of her street pounding grain for hours; she and her husband Sa'adu talk over the money, buy a grinding machine for the entrance hall of their house, solve the power problem with solar power, and charge a small fee.
lessons.text:
Hadiyya injiniya ce a wani kamfanin wutar lantarki a Gombe. Ita da mijinta Malam Sa'adu suna zaune a wata unguwar da mata suke daka hatsi kowace safiya. Kafin rana ta fito, ana jin ƙarar daka daga kowane gida.

Wata rana Hadiyya ta ga wata mace da take zaune kusa da su tana daka a ƙofar gidanta. Hannayenta sun yi ja, kuma ta gaji sosai. Matar ta ce wa Hadiyya, "Daka yana ɗaukar mini awa biyu kowace rana. Injin niƙa mafi kusa yana da nisa da mu."

Da yamma, Hadiyya ta yi magana da maigidanta. Ta ce, "Maigida, ina so mu yi wani sha'ani na kasuwanci. Mu sayi inji, mu sa shi a zauren gidanmu. Mata za su biya kuɗi kaɗan, su daina daka."

Malam Sa'adu ya ce, "Sha'anin kuɗi ba abu ne mai sauƙi ba. Injin yana da tsada. Kuma akwai matsalar samuwar wuta. Ba a samun wuta sosai a unguwar nan." Hadiyya ta ce, "Ni injiniya ce, kuma na san sha'anin wuta. Za mu sayi kayan wutar hasken rana. Ta haka, samuwar wuta ba za ta zama matsala ba."

Maigidan ya yi tunani na kwana biyu. Sannan ya ce, "Na yarda. Zan ba da rabin kuɗin, ke kuma ki ba da rabi." Suka sayi injin, suka sa shi a zauren gidansu. Hadiyya ta haɗa kayan wutar hasken rana a kan rufin zauren da kanta, saboda ita injiniya ce.

Ranar farko, mata uku ne kawai suka zo zauren. Suka biya kuɗi kaɗan, injin ya yi musu aikin awa biyu cikin minti biyar. Rana ta biyu, mata goma suka zo. Bayan mako ɗaya, zauren yana cike da mata da yara kowace safiya. Ƙarar daka ta ragu a unguwar.

Matar da ta yi magana da Hadiyya a farko ta ce, "Yanzu ina da lokacin yin wani aiki. Na fara sayar da abinci a ƙofar gida da lokacin da nake yi a daka." Malam Sa'adu ya yi farin ciki. Ya ce wa Hadiyya, "Wannan sha'ani ya yi kyau. Mun sami riba, kuma mun taimaki mata."

Bayan wata uku, maigidan Hadiyya ya ce, "Bari mu sayi inji na biyu." Hadiyya ta yi dariya ta ce, "Ashe maigida ma ya zama ɗan kasuwa!"

Tambayoyi:
Wane aiki Hadiyya take yi?
Ita injiniya ce a wani kamfanin wutar lantarki.
Me mata suke yi kowace safiya a unguwarsu?
Suna daka hatsi.
Ina Hadiyya da maigidanta suka sa injin?
Sun sa shi a zauren gidansu.
Yaya suka warware matsalar samuwar wuta?
Sun sayi kayan wutar hasken rana, Hadiyya ta haɗa su a kan rufin zauren.
Me matar da take zaune kusa da su ta fara yi?
Ta fara sayar da abinci a ƙofar gida da lokacin da take yi a daka.
